name: 32803 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32803 (Orlando) has 240 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32803 (Orlando) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32803 (Orlando) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32803 (Orlando) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
